svg.title: Driver Dreamer — White Emotion — Transparent Header
svg.desc: A paired editorial desktop website concept based on the preferred Chase the Feeling layout. The original transparent logo sits directly on blue sky beneath a transparent header. White CHASE THE typography with a fine navy edge and red FEELING typography sit above the untinted full-width Ferrari photo. A white circular-arrow action, white supporting copy and red model labels occupy clear racecourse areas. One white editorial collection section and a direct red footer complete the page.

g.text: FOR THE CARS THAT STAY WITH YOU

text.tspan: Make a place for your next dream.

g.text: RED EXTERIOR / TAN INTERIOR / SILVER WHEELS

text.tspan: Turn a passing obsession into a personal collection.
Keep the cars you love close.
See which one speaks to you.

g.text: A home for the cars you dream about.
